name: 고순
design: 여포와 같은 화면 크기·성인 남성 체격. 기병 요소 없이 넓은 어깨, 같은 얼굴 폭과 3~3.5등신 비율의 흑철 중갑 검보병.
prompt: Gao Shun only. Exact 8x8 transparent 64-sprite atlas preserving the v316 directions and actions. Match v317 Lu Bu adult male head width, shoulder width, torso mass and 3-3.5-head body ratio while remaining an infantry swordsman: no horse or mount. Preserve Gao Shun's black and dark-red lamellar armor, gold trim, black helmet, short red plume, straight sword, moustache and beard. Match the Lu Lingqi-family pixel rendering, spacing, foot baseline and action continuity. No extra character, shield, bow, text, grid, shadow or effects.
